第88章 坑赵霸，坑刀疤哥-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

“红旗，大壮，你们去前面那个路口等着，赵霸要是来的话，肯定会从那个路口赶过来，要是赵霸来了，你们一个回来通知我，另外一个这么和赵霸说……！”

李青山将谋略一一和赵红旗，大壮说了。

“山哥，你这招可真狠啊！”

赵红旗和大壮相互对视一眼后，纷纷忍不住给李青山竖了竖大拇指道。

旋即。

大壮和红旗去了前面的路口，李青山则是在这里等了起来，一般这种约架都是上午来，因为早晚要出事，上午打完，中午就去喝酒庆祝，刚好合适，当然了，每个地方的潜规则可能都不一样。

半个小时后，大壮便匆匆跑了过来，李青山看到大壮的身影后，便对旁边二壮使了个眼色，二壮匆忙朝着土乡那群小混混跑了过去，李青山则是抓紧去了土乡的派出所。

“赵霸，怎么就带了这几个小虾米？”赵红旗鼓足勇气迎了上去，望着赵霸带来的人道。

这一次，赵霸带了五个人，算上他自己一共六个人，也就是上次去李青山家里闹事的那几个，一个不多，一个也不少，每个人的手里都拎着棍子，还有藏着的砍刀。

一个个凶相毕露，约架打架这种事情，肯定是没少干。

赵红旗和大壮，包括李青山这一辈的人，在村子里都是被赵霸欺负长大的，赵红旗在见到赵霸后，心中多少还有些犯怵，但是想到自己背后站着的山哥后，心中又鼓足勇气。

“赵红旗，你个小瘪犊子说谁是小虾米呢？”

“信不信老子今天先整死你？”

赵霸拎着手中的自制砍刀，指着眼前的赵红旗，手臂之上青筋暴露，一副随时都有可能冲上去砍人的样子。

“赵霸，你在这里跟我装什么犊子，怎么，你们一群人还想整我一个人，以多欺少是不是？我过来就是为了告诉你，我家山哥的人在哪里等着，不然饮马河这么大，你们上哪里找去？”

赵红旗道。

“娘的，李青山那瘪犊子玩意，不是说老槐树那里吗？”赵霸皱眉道。

“哦，忘记山哥和你们说过了，行吧，但是在打之前山哥过来让我和你们谈几个规矩……！”

赵红旗在这里消磨时间，整的赵霸都有些不耐烦了，心中的怒火也早就压不住了，更是想着李青山这小鳖犊子玩意肯定是害怕了，不然哪有这么多废话，直接整不就完事了吗？

"Hongqi, Da Zhuang, you go and wait at the intersection ahead. If Zhao Ba comes, he will definitely come from that intersection. If Zhao Ba comes, one of you will come back and notify me, and the other one will tell Zhao Ba...!"

Li Qingshan told Zhao Hongqi one by one about his strategies.

"Brother Shan, your move is really cruel!"

After Zhao Hongqi and Da Zhuang looked at each other, they couldn't help but give Li Qingshan a thumbs up.

Immediately.

Da Zhuang and Hong Qi went to the intersection ahead, while Li Qingshan waited here. Generally, this kind of appointment would come in the morning, because something would happen sooner or later. After the fight in the morning, it would be just right to go drink and celebrate at noon. Of course, the unspoken rules of each place may be different.

Half an hour later, Da Zhuang hurried over. After Li Qingshan saw Da Zhuang's figure, he winked at the second Zhuang next to him. The second Zhuang hurriedly ran towards the group of gangsters in Tuxiang, while Li Qingshan hurried to the police station in Tuxiang.

"Zhao Ba, why did you bring these little shrimps?" Zhao Hongqi mustered up the courage to go forward and looked at the humanity that Zhao Ba brought.

This time, Zhao Ba brought five people, including himself, a total of six people, the same people who went to Li Qingshan's house to cause trouble last time. No one more, no less. Each of them was carrying a stick and a hidden machete in his hand.

Everyone showed their fierce looks, and they must have done things like getting into fights a lot.

Zhao Hongqi and Da Zhuang, including people of Li Qingshan's generation, were bullied by Zhao Ba in the village and grew up. After Zhao Hongqi saw Zhao Ba, he was still a little frightened, but when he thought of Brother Shan standing behind him, he plucked up the courage.

"Zhao Hongqi, you little brat, who do you think is Xiao Xiami?"

"Believe it or not, I will punish you to death today?"

Zhao Ba held the homemade machete in his hand and pointed it at Zhao Hongqi in front of him. The veins on his arm were exposed, and he looked like he might rush to kill someone at any time.

"Zhao Ba, what are you pretending to be like here? Why, you guys still want to punish me and bully the younger ones, right? I came here just to tell you where my brother Shan's people are waiting. Otherwise, where would you go to find the Yinma River when it's so big?"

Zhao Hongqi said.

"Damn it, didn't Li Qingshan's little thing come from the old locust tree?" Zhao Ba frowned.

"Oh, I forgot that Brother Shan told you, okay, but before the fight, Brother Shan came over and asked me to discuss a few rules with you...!"

Zhao Hongqi was spending time here, which made Zhao Ba a little impatient, and the anger in his heart could not be suppressed for a long time. He also thought that Li Qingshan, this little turtle kid, must be scared, otherwise there would be so much nonsense, couldn't it be done just now?
